dependencyChecks.purpose: Required original DLL for the raw HK Print QR encoder; verify only, never distribute.

state.v17Change: Print Friend QR uses the original Friend object as raw HK App Friend type3; MyTicket output and native input are retained.

privacy: All source bytes remain in the browser. Only prebuilt delta/static application assets are downloaded. No source, filename or checksum upload or telemetry.
limitations: This remains HK with restored native scenes and retained English keyboard fallback, not a full original Japanese arcade build.
Print emits the current eligible profile as a raw HK App MyTicket QR; guest/default profiles retain native Print fallback. General Japanese P-family login is not implemented.

Friend QR is generated from its own original Friend object, not the main player. Native input consumes its supported name, identity, outfit and six appearance fields; this is not a lossless mapping of every Print-only extra field.
Native self-ticket, duplicate-ticket, item/appearance and live-mode selection rules remain active. V17 Friend in-game recognition is not yet user-confirmed.
QRReader.dll is required and verified from the original archive; it is not included in the output ZIP or hosted on the server.
Virtual camera registration/capture helper and other Windows prerequisites are separate installation steps.
The earlier V19 Dream route was user-confirmed. V24 changes the order; that reordered flow and the new 100% DreamPrint output are not yet user-confirmed.
The unsuccessful experimental V21 fullscreen Fade correction is excluded; partial white transitions remain unresolved.

V22 changes CharaMake to start at hairstyle with native full-part availability. Isolated native lifecycle and ABI checks passed; a V22 normal-game playthrough is not yet user-confirmed. Stamp-rally ownership and entrance-retention debug options are not forced.

V24 retains the base Print/DreamPrint before BuyNew coins. GodLive is retained for TV live only in the supported current menu routes. Paid Shop may enter CharaMake when the first question is accepted; only additional purchases are printed afterward. Reordered V24 play has not been user-confirmed.

V28 prepares the native TV lottery before GodLive, preserves its first Shop item and native five-note pool, and connects item-note icons. Native item-linked appearance and guarantee branches remain active; there is no custom force100, high-rarity retry or new random winner selection. In-game V28 play is not yet user-confirmed.
